messages:
sara_pm: Quick sync 1: multiple AEs asking for a packaged offering: committed dedicated capacity + an optional priority routing add-on + burst credits. Need to nail v1 scope and launch criteria. I uploaded a sketch in the doc.

kevin_sales: Confirmed. Two Fortune customers requested SLA-like routing and predictable overflow. They want something we can reference in contract.

maria_revenue: Commercial constraint: burst billing must be predictable. Recommend fixed burst packs (10k/100k/1M tokens) + explicit overage rate. Also need clear SKU mapping for quoting tools.

alex_p: Clarify: "priority routing" = preferential queueing only, or reserved capacity that preempts other work? Implementation and promises differ a lot.

tim_eng: Engineering notes: soft-priority (queue weighting) is straightforward. Contracted priority (preemptive reserved headroom) requires scheduler changes and admission controls. We also need per-tenant burst meters emitting billing events. Rough timeline: 2 wks for soft-proto, 8 wks for contracted feature if prioritized.

kevin_sales: Sales playbook idea: sell "Priority Lite" (soft) for self-serve and "Priority Pro" (contracted) for enterprise with commits. For large deals allow custom pack sizes.

maria_revenue: Draft launch criteria: 1) product definition for soft vs contracted 2) SKU list + default pack sizes 3) billing telemetry (burst meters + events) 4) legal T&C draft for credits/compensation 5) quickstart docs.

legal_bot: Note: any SLA or credit formulas must be limited and pre-approved. I'll start a T&C redline once product def is stable.

tim_eng: Infra checklist: - routing policy API - tenant tagging + admission control - burst token meter + billing hook - safe fallback variant for overload (quantized model) We can prototype queue-weight changes in 2wks; full reserved headroom requires scheduler work and infra buy-in.

alex_p: UX: propose API flag priority: "soft"|"contracted" and optional burst_pack_id. Example: { model: "rwd-1", priority: "contracted", burst_pack_id: "bp-100k" } Also need examples in SDKs and console pricing UI.

kevin_sales: Also request an "emergency top-up" flow for sales to grant extra burst while legal finalizes terms. That should be auditable and billable.

maria_revenue: Pricing suggestion for v1: burst packs: [10k, 100k, 1M]. Overage at 2x hosted per-token price. Committed capacity discounts separate and expressed on reserved SKU.

sara_pm: Next steps: (1) Tim confirm infra blockers & timelines, (2) Alex prototype API examples, (3) Maria & Kevin produce SKU/pricing playbook, (4) Legal start T&C delta. Sync tomorrow 10:00.

tim_eng: Confirmed; prototype for demo in 2wks. Blocker: need scheduler tagging support.

legal_bot: Redline and checklist by EOD.

kevin_sales: I'll bring two anonymized RFP asks to 10:00 meeting.

maria_revenue: I'll bring sample contract language for burst billing.

sara_pm: Great. Linking doc: <https://docs.internal/redwood/pricing/priority-burst-offer> :white_check_mark:
